font-family.$description: Font family for P elements with .prose applied directly or that are a child of a .prose container.

font-size.$description: Font size for P elements with .prose applied directly or that are a child of a .prose container.

font-weight.$description: Font weight for P elements with .prose applied directly or that are a child of a .prose container.

line-height.$description: Line height for P elements with .prose applied directly or that are a child of a .prose container.

letter-spacing.$description: Tracking for P elements with .prose applied directly or that are a child of a .prose container.

measure.$description: Maximum inline measure for P elements with .prose applied directly or that are a child of a .prose container.

spacing-before.$description: Incoming spacing request when a paragraph follows another direct child in a .prose flow. The resolved gap is the larger of this spacing-before and the previous treatment's spacing-after, so structural hierarchy wins without relying on source order.

spacing-after.$description: Outgoing spacing request contributed by a paragraph to the next direct child in a .prose flow. The resolved gap is the larger of this spacing-after and the next treatment's spacing-before; documented compound pairs may intentionally use the tighter outgoing gap.

color.$description: Color of P elements with .prose applied directly or that are a child of a .prose container.

font-style.$description: Font style for P elements with .prose applied directly or that are a child of a .prose container.

text-transform.$description: Text transform for P elements with .prose applied directly or that are a child of a .prose container.

text-align.$description: Text alignment for P elements with .prose applied directly or that are a child of a .prose container.
